meta.note: Mock enforcement docket — plot encroachment and unsanctioned extra storeys. Not live CMBDA filings.
meta.agency: Greater Chennai Corporation · Building Regularisation Cell

encroachments.title: Cedar Walk wing into Indigo Quarters plot
encroachments.summary: Cedar Walk’s east podium was built across the sanctioned plot line into Indigo Quarters. Twin shows the illegal wing as a red volume sitting inside the neighbour’s cadastral box.
encroachments.action: Stop-work notice served. Joint survey with DoLR pending before mutation.

encroachments.title: Harbour Block service bay over Indigo setback
encroachments.summary: Harbour Block’s west service bay occupies Indigo Quarters’ rear setback. Overlap is a ground-level slab, not a full-height clash.
encroachments.action: Owner affidavit received. Regularisation vs demolition under review.

excess_floors.title: Horizon Tower — four storeys above sanctioned plan
excess_floors.name: Horizon Tower
excess_floors.summary: Occupation certificate lists 36 floors. Twin registry and mesh show 40. The red hat is the unsanctioned crown (F37–F40).
excess_floors.action: Lock new ULPIN issue on F37–F40 until demolition or compounding.

excess_floors.title: Meridian Peak — four unsanctioned storeys
excess_floors.name: Meridian Peak
excess_floors.summary: Plan sanction 36 floors; as-built 40. Red hat marks F37–F40 against the CMDA height cap.
excess_floors.action: Hold occupancy for upper four floors. FSI compounding file opened.

excess_floors.title: Glass Spire — four floors beyond OC
excess_floors.name: Glass Spire
excess_floors.summary: Tallest twin landmark. Sanctioned envelope stops at F36; mesh continues four floors. Red hat is the illegal crown.

excess_floors.title: Harbour Block — four extra midrise floors
excess_floors.name: Harbour Block
excess_floors.summary: Sanctioned G+7. Built G+11. Red hat is F9–F12, the four floors never approved.
excess_floors.action: Neighbour complaint from Indigo Quarters bundled with ENC-002.
